section:
### Additional comparison

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. The groups in this comparison were followed at the Northgate Heart Cohort.

Table 3. The measure for each arm, shown subset by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Mean | SD | n |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Standard care | Systolic drop | 11.9 | 6.0 | 800 |
| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Alvenor | Systolic drop | 14.6 | 7.3 | 800 |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Standard care | Systolic drop | 11.8 | 5.9 | 800 |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Alvenor | Systolic drop | 14.3 | 7.2 | 800 |

These values are listed for every arm and every subset.
